name: NIVEA Soft Moisturising Cream
ingredients: Aqua, Glycerin, Isopropyl Myristate, Glyceryl Stearate, Jojoba Oil
warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children.
warningRw: Gusa hanze gusa. Irinda guturika mu maso. Wubike kure y'abana.
instructions: Apply a small amount to skin and massage gently until absorbed.
instructionsRw: Shira agace gato ku ruhu maze unyure neza kugeza gisesekara.

name: Fair & Lovely Advanced Multi Vitamin
ingredients: Niacinamide, Vitamin B3, SPF 15, Glycerin, Aqua
warnings: Avoid prolonged sun exposure. Discontinue if irritation occurs.
warningRw: Irinda guturika cyane mu zuba. Hagarika niba uruhuje.
instructions: Apply evenly on face twice daily. Use sunscreen if going outdoors.
instructionsRw: Shira ku maso inshuro 2 ku munsi. Koresha sunscreen niba ugiye hanze.

name: Ultra White Skin Bleach Cream
warnings: DANGER: Contains illegal mercury and high-dose hydroquinone. Causes permanent skin damage and organ failure.
warningRw: AKAGA: Irimo mercury n'ibintu byangiza ubuzima. Bishobora gusenya uruhu no kwangiza ingingo z'umubiri.
instructions: DO NOT USE. Report to Rwanda FDA immediately.
instructionsRw: NTUKORESHE. Menyesha Rwanda FDA ako kanya.
